limitations: Six Linux physical hosts yield min/max exact median bounds with no simultaneous coverage across 12 cells. Mac paired bounds are descriptive and conditional on independent blocks; desktop and explicitly bound Claude activity remains measurement noise. No automatic adoption or PR follows; only observer repairs were retried prospectively with user authorization.

This is a categorical two-factor Additive microbenchmark with unit and varying positive weights, plus independent sparse-kernel correctness witnesses. It does not cover the complete fereg OLS/PPML/sloped workload matrix.
The roughly 344MiB factor/RHS figure is a retained-storage lower bound excluding maps, dense factors, observations and scratch; it is not peak RSS.
FNV scientific signatures are compact bit witnesses rather than cryptographic output-equality proofs; independent numerical witnesses are also required.
A passing nonregression interval is not a confidence claim of a speed improvement. All paired ratios, including the unfavorable block, are retained.
No new upstream PR, beta.11 adoption or publication is authorized by this record. Beta.11 must separately pass its existing fereg qualification against beta.10.

The completed Mac run retained five verified Claude executable identities, including two search helpers: 5.87 sampled CPU-seconds across 391 process samples, peak simultaneous sampled CPU 11.8%, peak summed RSS 2,475,936 KiB. These counters do not prove idle behavior or identify a causal timing effect.

Earlier Mac observer failures remain separate incomplete attempts. Their 32 successful timing calls and eight complete paired blocks are retained, with no selection, pooling or retrospective exclusion; two subsequent attempted rows were killed before native execution.

reason: All 12 Linux host-median threshold intervals and all 12 Mac descriptive intervals pass. One of 432 SCC mirrored blocks (scc-yk3, memory-weighted-apply-t4, block 4) exceeds the frozen max(5%, 1ms) rule and remains review-required. None of 72 completed Mac blocks exceeds that rule. Four earlier Mac observer attempts remain recorded, including 32 successful timings from eight complete paired blocks; the two killed children never passed the execution gate. No timing was discarded or pooled across attempts. This evidence does not adopt beta.11 or publish an upstream PR.

contract.affected: CSR row-bounds slicing only; multiplication/addition order and all scientific output bits remain unchanged.
contract.discrete: Example rejects missing Additive preconditioner, warnings, nonconvergence and unidentified columns before emitting JSON.
contract.independent_witness: maximum_error is the maximum absolute fitted-value error against known dyadic coefficients, modulo gauge; bound 1e-8. Complete solves also independently require every demeaned row <=1e-8 and finite.
contract.recurrence: recurrence_residual is an internal recurrence diagnostic, not the independent scientific norm; compare exactly and require finite.
contract.signature: science_fnv64 hashes coefficient bits and, for complete solves, demeaned bits, iterations and recurrence residual bits. This is a compact witness, not a cryptographic equality proof.
contract.work: explicit_apply_calls and iterations are actual reported counts; backsub_rows_per_apply/backsub_nnz_per_apply are derived design shape counts. Additive invokes BlockElimSolver back-substitution unconditionally.

science.cross_worker: Independent fitted-value witnesses pass at one/four workers for direct application; derived work counts and discrete success state agree. Four-worker full solves remain excluded for the documented frozen-base repeatability defect.
science.existing_invocation_counts_scope: native_invocations, preflight_invocations and timed_invocations are the six-host Linux campaign counts; Mac counts are recorded separately below.
science.fixed_worker_repeatability: Every invocation compared its warmup and final scientific signature; all subsequent invocations and both arms agreed exactly within each host/cell.

scope: Independent upstream back-substitution microbenchmark; beta.11 acceptance still requires the fereg bench/qualify.py campaign.
